headlines.title: IMAX (IMAX) CEO Defends Offering Premium Screens To A High Profile Streaming Release
headlines.summary: IMAX (NYSE:IMAX) CEO publicly addressed decisions by major theater chains to forgo showing a high profile Netflix film on IMAX screens. The chief executive said the company had offered IMAX auditoriums for the Netflix title while some exhibition partners held back. Management framed the episode as part of broader talks with studios and streaming platforms over how premium screens are allocated.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
